recruit.description: Building innovative AI-powered recruitment solutions using modern web technologies and machine learning.
recruit.longDescription: At Re:cruit, I develop comprehensive web applications and AI-powered features for recruitment platform. Working with cutting-edge technologies including LLMs, real-time collaboration tools, and advanced text processing systems.
responsibilities: Developed a feature enabling summary generation and conversation with documents, leveraging Instructor and Pydantic across various LLMs
Implemented CRUD-based functionalities on a Flask server
Built a comprehensive web application adhering to Figma designs, using NextJS and TypeScript
Written end-to-end tests employing Playwright for a NextJS application

Engineered a sophisticated rich text editor, featuring commenting, mentioning, and highlighting capabilities, utilizing PlateJS, enhanced by real-time multi-user editing synchronization through PubNub
Crafted a native-like web application interface with ReactJS for integration into a Mac application via web view
Developed comprehensive test suites for NextJS applications utilizing Jest and Playwright
Spearheaded the creation of a full-stack resume-building application with NextJS, TypeScript, Prisma, and Stitches, integrating PostgreSQL for data storage and OpenAI API for content enhancement
Engineered a large-scale language corpus testing tool using Python, enabling extensive data analysis and system optimization
Implemented an authentication system using MagicLink and contributed to the design of several web pages for a DAO, leveraging NextJS
achievements: Built advanced AI-powered document processing features using multiple LLMs
Implemented real-time collaborative text editing with multi-user synchronization
Developed comprehensive resume-building application with AI enhancement capabilities
Created large-scale language corpus testing tools for data analysis

edgep-instructor.description: Provided expert lectures on Python and machine learning to university students as part of a World Bank backed government initiative.
edgep-instructor.longDescription: As an industry expert, delivered comprehensive training on Python programming and machine learning concepts to students from top universities in Bangladesh. This project is managed by ICT Division of Bangladesh government and backed by World Bank.
responsibilities: Delivered lectures on Python fundamentals including pandas, numpy, and scikit-learn libraries
Taught machine learning concepts including regression, clustering, and classification algorithms
Demonstrated construction of user interfaces using Flask framework
Provided training to students from Shahjalal University of Science and Technology, Jagannath University, and Stamford University Bangladesh
achievements: Successfully trained students from 3 major universities in Bangladesh
Contributed to government-backed digital skills development initiative
Delivered comprehensive curriculum covering both programming fundamentals and advanced ML concepts

traders-connect.description: Developed foundational infrastructure and mobile applications for a large-scale trading platform using React Native and modern web technologies.
traders-connect.longDescription: Led the development of foundational front-end infrastructure and cross-platform mobile applications for an upcoming large-scale trading platform, focusing on performance, security, and user experience.
responsibilities: Developed the foundational front-end infrastructure for an upcoming large-scale web application
Written native modules in Swift to seamlessly connect a React Native app with a gRPC server
Crafted a customized and reusable component library in React Native, utilizing styled-components for cross-platform mobile application
Engineered a cross-platform mobile application featuring over 20 distinct screens using React Native
Implemented OAuth to secure authentication processes within a React Native application
achievements: Built comprehensive mobile application with 20+ screens
Created reusable component library for cross-platform development
Successfully integrated native Swift modules with React Native

kaz-software.description: Led design and development of complex web applications, specializing in ReactJS, TypeScript, and modern frontend architectures.
kaz-software.longDescription: At Kaz Software, I led the design and development of large-scale web applications, focusing on performance optimization, micro-frontend architecture, and automated testing. Worked extensively with modern React ecosystems and deployment technologies.
responsibilities: Led the design of over 40 pages for a complex web application, catering to two distinct user interfaces with ReactJS, TypeScript, SWR, Redux-Toolkit, RSuite, and SCSS
Successfully upgraded two web applications from ReactJS version 16 to version 18, enhancing performance and compatibility
Merged four separate ReactJS applications into a unified micro-frontend platform using Single-SPA
Improved deployment efficiency by containerizing applications with Docker
Authored end-to-end automated tests for a ReactJS web application utilizing Cypress
Engineered and implemented a range of features across two ReactJS web applications, employing TypeScript for development
achievements: Successfully designed and implemented 40+ complex web application pages
Led React 16 to 18 migration for multiple applications, improving performance
Architected micro-frontend platform consolidating 4 separate applications
Implemented comprehensive end-to-end testing with Cypress

bengali-ai.description: Developed web applications for Bengali language processing and machine learning model benchmarking using React and Python.
bengali-ai.longDescription: At Bengali.AI, I contributed to advancing Bengali language technology by developing web applications for benchmarking text-to-speech models and creating integration layers between machine learning models and web interfaces.
responsibilities: Developed a web application with ReactJS, designed for benchmarking various Bengali text-to-speech models
Created a Python-based Flask wrapper server to integrate machine-learning models with the ReactJS application via web-socket
achievements: Built comprehensive benchmarking platform for Bengali text-to-speech models
Successfully integrated ML models with web interface using WebSocket communication
Contributed to Bengali language processing research and development
